About the author

LJ Cohen is the author of eight novels across the science fiction and fantasy genres. DERELICT, the first book in her Halcyone Space series, was named a Library Journal self-e select title and book of the year in 2014 and has been an Amazon best seller. Her ninth novel, LITANY FOR A BROKEN WORLD will be published in February of 2025.
A retired physical therapist, LJ now uses her clinical knowledge and skills to injure characters in her stories. She serves on the board of Broad Universe and is a full member of SFWA (Science Fiction and Fantasy Writers Association).
